lines.zh: : 只要能见上 Futaba 一面就是好事，行！马上回来！

lines.en: scene wakanabeachttl23
: ...Is what I {i}would{/i} say if I was not a {i}liar!{/i}
lines.zh: : ……如果我是个{i}诚实{/i}的人，我就{i}会{/i}这么说！

lines.en: : Enjoy being locked in there until morning, {i}suckers.{/i} Operation: Jim Halpert is a go after all! I just needed to work alone this time!
lines.zh: : 好好享受被锁在里面直到天亮吧，{i}蠢货们{/i}。「Jim Halpert 行动」终究还是要执行的！只不过这次我需要单独行动！

lines.en: : Go! Time! Sleep? Bed!
lines.zh: : 走！时间！睡觉？床！

lines.en: : Uhh...what are you guys doing?
lines.zh: : 呃……你们在干嘛？

lines.en: scene wakanabeachttl24
: Wha...what are {i}you two{/i} doing?! Shouldn’t you be in bed right now?!
lines.zh: : 什……{i}你们俩{/i}在干嘛？！你们现在不是该在床上吗？！

lines.en: : It’s only like 10:30. Why would we be asleep?
lines.zh: : 才十点半左右。我们为什么要睡觉？

lines.en: scene wakanabeachttl25
: Wow, really? Is that it? It felt way later.
lines.zh: : 哇，真的吗？才这么晚？我感觉已经很晚了。

lines.en: : Is...Miss Imai okay? Do you...need help...taking her somewhere?
lines.zh: : Imai 老师……没事吧？你们……需要帮忙送她去哪儿吗？

lines.en: : She’s fine. Just steer clear of this room for the next twelve hours. Do you understand?
lines.zh: : 她没事。接下来十二小时离这间房远点。明白吗？

lines.en: : Why? Did you trap Sensei and Miss Watabe in there in an effort to make them finally sleep together?
lines.zh: : 为什么？你把 Sensei 和 Watabe 老师关在里面，好让他们终于睡到一起了？

lines.en: scene wakanabeachttl26

: Wha...{i}no!{/i} You mean like in the eighth season of The Office where Jim and Cathy are forced to sleep in the same room and Jim needs to overcome temptation in order to progress?! That would be, like...so dumb!
lines.zh: : 什……{i}不是！{/i}你是说就像《The Office》第八季里 Jim 和 Cathy 被迫睡在同一间房、Jim 必须克服诱惑才能往前走那样？！那也太……太蠢了吧！

lines.en: : Okay...Because we would...probably be okay with avoiding the room if...that’s what was happening...
lines.zh: : 好吧……因为如果……真是那样的话，我们大概……会愿意避开那间房的……

lines.en: : But, since it’s not...
lines.zh: : 但既然不是……

lines.en: scene wakanabeachttl27
: Wait, hold on. Really?
lines.zh: : 等等，等等。真的吗？

lines.en: : Oh, sure. Pretty much everybody in the light music club except Chika wants those two to sleep together. It’s kind of wild they haven’t yet.
lines.zh: : 哦，当然。轻音部里除了 Chika，基本上所有人都希望那两个睡到一起。他们到现在还没成，也够离谱的。

lines.en: : I see...
lines.zh: : 这样啊……

lines.en: : Who are we talkin’ about?! I wanna join in!
lines.zh: : 你们在说谁？！我也要加入！

lines.en: : In that case, the two of you never saw anything. Understood?
lines.zh: : 既然如此，你们俩什么都没看见。明白？

lines.en: : Loud and clear.
lines.zh: : 明白得很。

lines.en: : Want us to stand guard?
lines.zh: : 要我们站岗吗？

lines.en: : Could you? I need to get this one back to her room before she throws up on the carpet.
lines.zh: : 能吗？我得把这个家伙送回她房间，别让她吐在地毯上。

lines.en: scene wakanabeachttl28
: Is it just me or has Rika been gone for a while now?
lines.zh: : 是只有我觉得，还是 Rika 确实去了挺久了？

lines.en: : She probably forgot which room we were in and gave up.
lines.zh: : 她大概是忘了我们在哪间房，然后放弃了。

lines.en: : Should I, like...go look for her something?
lines.zh: : 我要不要……去找找她什么的？

lines.en: : Just text her. Phones exist for a reason.
lines.zh: : 给她发短信就行。手机存在的意义就在这儿。

lines.en: : My phone’s in my room. Do you have yours?
lines.zh: : 我手机在房间里。你的呢？

lines.en: : Rika took it so I wouldn’t be {i}distracted{/i} during bar night.
lines.zh: : Rika 收走了，好让我在酒吧之夜{i}不分心{/i}。

lines.en: : I’ll be right back then. I-
lines.zh: : 那我马上回来。我——

lines.en: : Huh? That’s weird.
lines.zh: : 嗯？真奇怪。

lines.en: scene wakanabeachttl29
: The door is locked.
lines.zh: : 门被锁了。

lines.en: : From the outside? Amazing. I’m sure Rika had nothing to do with this at all and that this resort is merely just terrible when it comes to security and safety.
lines.zh: : 从外面锁的？真厉害。我敢肯定这事跟 Rika 一点关系都没有，这家度假村在安保这方面纯属烂透了。

lines.en: scene wakanabeachttl30
: So, what do we-
lines.zh: : 那我们该——

lines.en: scene wakanabeachttl31
: Oh.
: {i}I’m{/i} going to sleep.
lines.zh: : {i}我要{/i}睡了。

lines.en: : It’s clear she isn’t coming back and I’m too drunk and miserable to continue existing anyway.
lines.zh: : 她显然不会回来了，而我醉得、惨得也没力气继续存在下去了。

lines.en: : I see that didn’t stop you from taking the last few beers we had to your nightstand, though.
lines.zh: : 看来这并不妨碍你把最后那几瓶啤酒搬到床头柜上。

lines.en: : I need them there in case I get thirsty in the middle of the night.
lines.zh: : 我得放在那儿，万一半夜渴了呢。

lines.en: scene wakanabeachttl32
: Do you want to talk?
lines.zh: : 你想聊聊吗？

lines.en: : No. I want to die.
lines.zh: : 不想。我想死。

lines.en: : Me too, but we’re in this together. And we’d both be equally mad if the other died.
lines.zh: : 我也是，可我们是绑在一起的。而且要是对方死了，我们两个都会同样生气。

lines.en: : I would dance on your grave and I have never once danced a day in my life.
lines.zh: : 我会在你坟头上跳舞——我这辈子可从没跳过舞。

lines.en: : So, how’s Osako?
lines.zh: : 那，Osako 怎么样？

lines.en: : Wonderful. It’s {i}me{/i} who should not inhabit this planet anymore. And I am an idiot for believing we could face the future together.
lines.zh: : 好极了。该从这颗星球上消失的是{i}我{/i}。我真是个白痴，居然相信我们能一起面对未来。

lines.en: : You’re not an idiot for proposing to the woman you’re in love with, Wakana. You’re an idiot for thinking you {i}could{/i} get married considering Japan does not allow that.
lines.zh: : 你向自己爱的女人求婚，这不算白痴，Wakana。白痴的是你以为你们{i}能{/i}结婚——毕竟日本不允许。

lines.en: : For what it’s worth, I did include that in the proposal. Just none of it matters anymore because we’re on a “break” and that’s just the adult way of saying we’re absolutely fucking {i}fucked.{/i}
lines.zh: : 说句公道话，我在求婚时把这一点也考虑进去了。只是现在都不重要了，因为我们在「冷静期」，而这不过是成年人用来表达「我们他妈的{i}彻底完蛋了{/i}」的说法。

lines.en: : Is she, like...living somewhere else then? Are {i}you{/i} living somewhere else?
lines.zh: : 那她是……住到别处了？还是{i}你{/i}住到别处了？

lines.en: scene wakanabeachttl33
: We’re both still in the apartment. But she sleeps on the couch now since she’s trying to be {i}nice{/i} and not damage my back.
lines.zh: : 我们还住在那间公寓里。只是她现在睡沙发，因为她是{i}好心{/i}，不想弄坏我的背。

lines.en: : Frankly, I’d rather it just break. So dramatically and painfully, in fact, that the only thing doctors would be able to do for me is numb me {i}permanently{/i} via euthanasia.
lines.zh: : 说实话，我倒宁愿它就这么断掉。断得那么戏剧、那么痛，痛到医生唯一能为我做的就是给我{i}永久{/i}麻醉——也就是安乐死。

lines.en: : You guys will figure it out, Wakana. You always do.
lines.zh: : 你们会解决的，Wakana。你们一向都会。

lines.en: : No, Arakawa. {i}We won’t.{/i} Not this time. This isn’t just some stupid {i}fight{/i} or a {i}misunderstanding.{/i}
lines.zh: : 不，Arakawa。{i}这次不会。{/i}这不是什么愚蠢的{i}吵架{/i}，也不是{i}误会{/i}。

lines.en: : It’s a misalignment of ideals and desires and, more than anything, a testament to the fact that despite what we both {i}want,{/i} we simply aren’t right for one another.
lines.zh: : 这是理想与欲望的错位，更是在证明：不管我们各自{i}想要{/i}什么，我们就是不合适。

lines.en: scene wakanabeachttl34
: Now, please excuse me as I pass out and dream of being crushed by the moon.
lines.zh: : 现在请原谅我，我要昏过去了，去梦见自己被月亮压碎。

lines.en: : You really think I’m going to let you sleep on that note?
lines.zh: : 你真以为我会让你在这种状态下睡着？

lines.en: : No. But could you at least turn the light off so the brightness no longer hurts my eyes?
lines.zh: : 不会。但能不能至少把灯关了，别让亮光刺我的眼睛？

lines.en: : Have you taken your medication tonight? Whatever that medication {i}is{/i} now.
lines.zh: : 你今晚吃药了吗？不管现在吃的是{i}什么{/i}药。

lines.en: : {i}Yes,{/i} Arakawa. Why? Is someone paying you to be my nurse?
lines.zh: : {i}吃了，{/i}Arakawa。怎么？有人花钱雇你当我的护士吗？

lines.en: scene wakanabeachttl35
: I’m just worried about you. I’ve never seen you drink this much before and I feel like you’re just putting on a brave face right now since all of your friends are here.
lines.zh: : 我只是担心你。我从没见你喝过这么多，而且我觉得你现在只是在硬撑——毕竟你所有的朋友都在场。

lines.en: : I was about to ask you exactly what your idea of a “brave face” means but then I remembered who I am talking to and realized you just have no clue at all.
lines.zh: : 我本来想问问你「硬撑」到底是什么意思，但我一想起自己是在跟谁说话，就意识到你根本一点概念都没有。

lines.en: : You’re giving up.
lines.zh: : 你在放弃。

lines.en: : At least I’m not crying.
lines.zh: : 至少我没哭。

lines.en: : Do you {i}want{/i} to?
lines.zh: : 你想{i}哭{/i}吗？

lines.en: : No, you fucking idiot. Who ever {i}wants{/i} to cry? It feels bad, it makes your head hurt, it gives you congestion, and it makes you utterly hideous.
lines.zh: : 不想，你他妈这个白痴。谁{i}会想{/i}哭？那感觉很糟，会头疼，会鼻塞，还会让你变得极其难看。

lines.en: : I don’t mind seeing you when you’re hideous, you know.
lines.zh: : 我不介意看到你难看的样子，你知道的。

lines.en: : Then bust that god damn door down and get me something else to drink as my impending jaundice would likely please both of us right now.
lines.zh: : 那就把那扇该死的门撞开，再给我弄点喝的——反正我马上就要得黄疸了，那副样子大概能让你我都开心。

lines.en: : Is there anything I can {i}actually{/i} do? That will help. Even if it’s just a little.
lines.zh: : 有什么我能做的吗？{i}真正{/i}有用的。哪怕只有一点点。

lines.en: scene wakanabeachttl36
: Turn the lights off and put Gilmore Girls on the TV. I fucking hate the show, but they talk very quickly and it will distract me from my thoughts.
lines.zh: : 把灯关了，电视上放《Gilmore Girls》。我他妈讨厌那部剧，但他们说话特别快，能让我不去想事情。

lines.en: : Anything else?
lines.zh: : 还有别的吗？

lines.en: : Not unless you know “She Walks in Beauty” by heart.
lines.zh: : 除非你能背出《She Walks in Beauty》。

lines.en: : She walks in beauty, like the night. Of cloudless climes and starry skies.
lines.zh: : 她走在美的光彩中，像夜晚。皎洁无云，繁星漫天。

lines.en: scene wakanabeachttl37
: Oh, {i}now{/i} you’re suddenly letting the poetic side of you out again. Fantastic. Exceptional timing as always, Arakawa.
lines.zh: : 哦，你{i}又{/i}突然把你那诗意的一面放出来了。真棒。时机照例选得极好，Arakawa。

lines.en: : And all that’s best of dark and bright meet in her aspect and her eyes.
lines.zh: : 而明与暗最美妙的色泽，都在她的仪容和秋波里呈现。

lines.en: : Stop. Upon reflection, I’ve realized you’re going to ruin that poem for me. I’d like to just lie here in silence instead, please.
lines.zh: : 停下。想了想，我发现你会把这首诗给我毁掉的。我宁愿就这么静静地躺着，谢谢。

lines.en: : Sure. I’ll go set a futon up in the living room and leave you alone. Sorry for-
lines.zh: : 好。我去客厅铺床，不再打扰你。抱歉——

lines.en: scene wakanabeachttl38
: Don’t leave me alone.
lines.zh: : 别留下我一个人。

lines.en: : What? But you-
lines.zh: : 什么？可你——

lines.en: scene wakanabeachttl39
: I want you with me right now. Sleep here instead.
lines.zh: : 我现在想让你在我身边。睡这儿吧。

lines.en: : Uhh...
: Please?...
lines.zh: : 求你了？……

lines.en: : This is...quite the 180 out of nowhere, I must admit.
lines.zh: : 这……转得也太突然了，我得承认。

lines.en: : Arakawa, I only bicker like this with you because it brings me joy. You should know by now I mean very little of it.
lines.zh: : Arakawa，我之所以只跟你这样斗嘴，是因为这让我快乐。你早该知道，我说的大多不是真心话。

lines.en: : So when I tell you to leave, please just always assume I’m saying “Don’t go.”
lines.zh: : 所以当我叫你走的时候，请永远当成我在说「别走」。

lines.en: scene wakanabeachttl40
: Now, if you’ll excuse me, I’m going to go back to pretending I hate you right now so I can trick myself into thinking things are normal when they very clearly are not.
lines.zh: : 好了，失陪一下，我要继续装作讨厌你了，好骗自己以为一切正常——明明再清楚不过，一切都不正常。

lines.en: : Wow. You’re {i}really{/i} drunk if you’re just going to come out and be all cute like that.
lines.zh: : 哇。你居然就这么直接说出这种可爱的话，看来是{i}真{/i}醉了。

lines.en: : Can you pull the covers over me? I can’t move.
lines.zh: : 能帮我把被子拉上来吗？我动不了。

lines.en: scene black
: Yes, Wakana.
lines.zh: : 好，Wakana。

lines.en: : I can pull the covers over you.
lines.zh: : 我可以帮你把被子拉上来。

lines.en: $ beachsevenwakana1 = True
$ wakana_love += 5
{i}Wakana’s affection has increased to [wakana_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Wakana 的好感度提升到了 [wakana_love]！{/i}
